SAS Administration Community

SAS Programming Community

SAS Developer Portal

SAS Data Science Blog
SAS Data Science Community

SAS
®
 Viya
®
 Platform
 
 
 
Overview
Learn & Support 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SAS
®
 Viya
® 
 Platform
Quickly transform raw data into operational insights that support every kind of decision your organization makes. The SAS Viya platform is an AI, analytic and data management platform that runs on a modern, scalable architecture.

What's New in the SAS Viya Platform

 

 

 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 

Videos


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SAS Enterprise Guide: Tips, Tricks and Considerations for Programmers
In this webinar, SAS programmers can discover tips, tricks and little-known functionalities in SAS Enterprise Guide.
 
 
 
 
 
 
A Deeper Dive into SAS Enterprise Guide Reporting
This session assumes that you already have some proficiency with SAS Enterprise Guide, but want to learn more about the tasks that conduct reporting.
 
 
 
 
 
 
SAS Visual Forecasting on SAS Viya: Getting Started
Join us for this webinar and learn how SAS Visual Forecasting on SAS Viya supports high-performance automated forecasting and how to start using it.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Cluster Analysis: Introduction to Best Practices
Join a SAS expert to learn some of the best practices to consider when doing cluster analysis, particularly when applied to customer relationship management.

Training Courses
Learn SAS technology quickly and efficiently by taking a course from the analytics experts.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 SAS
 
Viya Overview
 
 
 
 

 

Providing an introduction to the applications in SAS Viya, this course discusses how each is used in the phases of the SAS Analytics Life Cycle: Data, Discovery, Deployment, and Orchestration.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 SAS
 
Viya Administration: Getting Started 
(Free E-Learning)
 
 
 
 

 

Designed for platform administrators, this course provides an overview of how to best administer SAS Viya.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Programming for SAS
 
Viya
 
 
 
 

 

Created for users who need to modify existing Base SAS programs to execute in SAS Viya, this course leverages the power of SAS Cloud Analytic Services (CAS) to access, manage, and manipulate in-memory tables. This course is not intended for beginning SAS software users.
